name: brain-zanegpt
description: ZaneGPT reasoning backed by an offline Brain knowledge snapshot and persistent local mining.

interface.shortDescription: ZaneGPT reasoning with offline Brain memory
interface.longDescription: Use ZaneGPT's complete reasoning and voice instructions while querying a versioned, read-only Brain snapshot and mining durable local lessons. Local knowledge stays outside the plugin and survives upgrades.
defaultPrompt: Ask Brain what it knows about this problem, then answer as ZaneGPT.
Mine the reusable lessons from this project into my local Brain store.
Pressure-test a gastrointestinal diagnosis while separating evidence from interpretation.
